notes: Stands in for the shop's ProtoTRAK 1745 toolroom lathe: no TRAK or ProtoTRAK model turned up, and this generic model is a much bigger lathe (194 in long). The file stands it on its back, so it is read +Z up. Centres and swing are estimates; the model has no maker.
